meta.title: An unknown resource type skips every permission check and reports an error as success

direct.expectedResult: Expected (today): HTTP 200 with body {"error": "Reminders does not exist"} and no permission check at all (authorize_resource and reminder_service_for only know event_group). Should be a 422; suspected defect: an error reported with a success status. A 5xx would be a new defect.
